column1: # A verification corpus: 1800 molecules, `group name SMILES`.
# Drawn 20261004 from two sources -- random byte offsets into PubChem's
# CID-SMILES, and a shuffle of COCONUT's natural products -- stratified into
# heavy-atom buckets of 5-15, 16-25, 26-35, 36-50 and 51-70 so that the large
# flexible molecules are not swamped by small rigid ones. Natural products are
# in because a PubChem sample is short of macrocycles, glycosides, terpenes
# Filtered only on what the comparison needs: a single fragment RDKit can
# parse and MMFF94 can type, 5 to 70 heavy atoms. NOT filtered on whether we
# can embed it -- the corpus that this replaces was, which hides our own
# failures, so here they stay in and are counted.
# This corpus decides nothing. It is read once to find out whether the
# choices made on the tuning corpora generalise, and if anything is changed
# in response it is spent and a new one has to be drawn.
